tags.tr: The response answers both questions, but the proposed preservation strategy is vague.

tr_details.content: Schools and governments must do things to keep both languages living
tr_details.comment: Explain exactly what schools and governments should do.
tr_details.revision: Schools should provide bilingual classes, while governments should fund local-language media and cultural programmes.
tr_details.combined_tagged: Replace the vague proposal with specific preservation measures.

tags.cc: Clear overall structure with an introduction, contrasting body paragraphs and a conclusion.

cc_details.comment: Use a more formal transition and precise wording.

tags.gr: Frequent errors occur in subject–verb agreement, verb forms, articles and plurals.

focus.title: Subject–verb agreement and verb forms
focus.explanation: Practise forms such as “people speak,” “it makes,” “they are” and “we lose.” Correcting these frequent errors would substantially improve accuracy.
